shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: document beforeSession error handling guarantees in hooks spec

Fixes acceptance test compilation errors and documents the behavior when
beforeSession throws. Clarifies that errors reach the caller as rejections,
onError hook fires with the error, and afterSession hook always fires to
enable cleanup, with the guarantee that no tools were run and no provider
was called when beforeSession fails.

Splits the acceptance test into three separate tests to comply with the
max-expects linting rule and adds spec links to validate each aspect
separately: rejection propagation, onError firing, and afterSession firing.

Updates spec to move beforeSession behavior from measured-semantics/out-of-scope
to a documented guarantee, and links related tests about hook optionality.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
